`abstract class StringSliderNode`<br/>
**Extends:** [`SliderNode<String>`](/reference/controls/slidernode/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.impl.control.slider` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [StringSliderNode.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/impl/control/slider/StringSliderNode.java)

A slider over a list of texts, such as quality levels, given as texts or as the constants of an enum.

![A slider above the labels Low, Medium and High, its thumb on Medium; the pointer presses High, then Low, then drags the thumb back to Medium](/captures/catalog-controls-stringslidernode.webp)

## Description

A skin extends it and gives its parts as for any [`SliderNode`](/reference/controls/slidernode/); `values(String...)` and `value(String)` of [`BaseChoiceNode`](/reference/controls/basechoicenode/) take the texts themselves.

## Creation details

<a id="StringSliderNode-constructor"></a>

### StringSliderNode

`StringSliderNode(double x, double y, double width, double height)` <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Creates the slider at `x`, `y` with a `width` and a `height` in design pixels, from the constructor of a skin.

## Method details

<a id="StringSliderNode-method-values"></a>

### values

`this values(Enum<?>... values)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Gives the options the names of enum constants, in the order given.

<a id="StringSliderNode-method-value"></a>

### value

`this value(Enum<?> value)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Selects the option named after an enum constant.
Throws an `IllegalArgumentException` when it is not one of the options.
